business_summary: Wanda Hotel Development Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the trading and property leasing business in Mainland China, Hong Kong, and internationally. It operates through two segments: Leasing of investment properties, and Trading and leasing of overseas properties. The company was formerly known as Wanda Commercial Properties (Group) Co., Limited and changed its name to Wanda Hotel Development Company Limited in October 2014. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Central, Hong Kong. Wanda Hotel Development Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Wanda Commercial Properties Overseas Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Wanda Hotel Development Company Limited는 중국 본토, 홍콩 및 국제적으로 무역 및 부동산 임대 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 투자부동산 임대와 해외부동산 거래 및 임대의 두 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Wanda Commercial Properties (Group) Co., Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2014년 10월에 Wanda Hotel Development Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 2000년에 법인화되었으며 홍콩 센트럴에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Wanda Hotel Development Company Limited는 Wanda Commercial Properties Overseas Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
